en.headline: Hong Kong students slip in PISA rankings but stay above global average
en.dek: Science falls out of the top 10 for the first time while digital-learning scores rank sixth; Education Bureau notes scores remain above OECD means and will review the findings.
body: Hong Kong 15-year-olds recorded lower rankings in mathematics, science and reading in the latest Programme for International Student Assessment results released on Tuesday, though scores in all three core domains remained above the international average.

According to figures announced by the University of Hong Kong’s Faculty of Education, which conducted the local study for the Education Bureau, students scored 522 in mathematics (seventh place), 496 in science (around 16th–17th) and 480 in reading (15th). Science dropped out of the global top 10 for the first time since Hong Kong joined the OECD assessment. Mainland China’s Beijing-Shanghai-Jiangsu-Zhejiang cluster, Singapore and Macao occupied the top three places in science and mathematics.

In the innovative domain “Learning in the Digital World”, Hong Kong students scored 545 against an international average of 500 and ranked sixth. The Education Bureau said the digital result reflected the effectiveness of STEAM education and that overall performance continued to exceed international averages. It added that the cohort had experienced Covid-related disruption during a critical learning stage and that it would examine the detailed findings with researchers and stakeholders.

zh.headline: PISA港生數學科學閱讀排名齊跌 仍高於國際平均
zh.dek: 科學首次跌出全球前十，數碼學習領域排名第六；教育局指三個核心範疇得分仍高於經合組織平均，將檢視結果。
body: 經濟合作與發展組織最新公布的學生能力國際評估計劃（PISA）2025結果顯示，本港15歲學生在數學、科學及閱讀三個核心領域的排名均較上屆下跌，但分數仍高於國際平均水平。
港大教育學院今日公布本港結果。數學得分522分、排名第七；科學496分、排名約第16至17位，首次跌出全球前十；閱讀480分、排名第15位。科學及數學頭三名分別為內地京滬蘇浙、新加坡及澳門。
創新領域「在數碼世界中學習」方面，本港學生取得545分，高於國際平均500分，排名第六。教育局表示，數碼領域表現印證STEAM教育成效，整體成績持續高於國際平均；參與學生在關鍵發展期受疫情影響，局方將與研究團隊及持份者仔細分析結果，了解學習需要。
